description:
Verify an x402 purchase actually settled and delivered what you paid for:
submit bounded, non-secret metadata for the payment requirement, payment
response, delivery receipt and settlement reference, and receive a single
deterministic verdict — proven, conflicting, or missing — field by field,
suitable to attach to a refund request or dispute.
Limitation: verdicts are computed from the artifacts you provide; we do not
fetch chain state or contact the provider on your behalf.

delivery_receipt.description: Bounded delivery receipt metadata. No payload bodies or secrets.

payment_requirement.description: Bounded non-secret payment requirement metadata from the 402.

payment_response.description: Bounded non-secret payment response metadata. No signatures.

settlement_ref.description: Bounded settlement reference metadata. No private keys.

name: util_x402_lifecycle_reconcile
